Chapter President 2026–2027

Precious Manucom

Precious leads DEVCON Manila, the network’s largest community with 5.4k+ members and the 2025 Academe and Industry Linkage Champion. The chapter’s year ran from the Game On! Game Jam to Hour of AI in five Manila public schools. Precious puts people first, growing volunteers ahead of checking off tasks.

Meet all chapter presidents

About Metro Manila

Did you know?

Manila’s role as a major economic hub, plus a fast-growing startup scene, has drawn major international investment in FinTech and e-commerce. The result: new payment solutions and logistics advances that make Manila a key player in Southeast Asia’s digital economy.

Local economy: Metro Manila produces about a third of the country’s economy, led by services, finance, and IT-BPM. Technology can help transform government services, fintech, and the next wave of AI-assisted work in the BPO sector.

2025 impact report

Five high-impact events at the center

Unique tech topics

  • Game jams
  • Smart contracts
  • Women in tech
  • Blockchain
  • Hour of AI

Manila kicked off 2025 with the Game On! Game Jam, then brought hands-on smart contract code camps to universities through Grassroots Blockchain in Education (DEVCON × ICP).

Elevate and Empowher: She is DEVCON × UXPH inspired hundreds of women toward leadership in development and design. The chapter spotlighted iThink Hackathon finalists at Philippine Blockchain Week, and took its mission global at WOCEE. Its first Hour of AI in the District of Manila reached 600 learners in 5 public schools.

Quality over quantity

We grow chapters, not pins on a map

A DEVCON chapter is more than a location. It needs active officers, regular local programs, and shared standards. Becoming an active chapter follows a stringent process that tests commitment, readiness, and long-term alignment with DEVCON as a non-profit, beyond seed funds and tech hype.

Limited capacity, by design. As a volunteer community, we can only support so many chapters well, and we have not renewed a total of 4 chapters for non-compliance and inactivity to date. We will always prioritize quality over quantity, of both events and impact. See chapter application requirements

First-time visitor guide

Visiting Metro Manila for the first time?

Make time for these must-visit spots while you’re in town.

  • IntramurosThe walled Spanish-era city, Fort Santiago, and San Agustin Church.
  • National Museum of the PhilippinesFree-entry museums of fine arts, anthropology, and natural history.
  • BinondoThe world’s oldest Chinatown and its food crawl.
  • Rizal ParkManila’s historic central park by the bay.

Active officer perk: as a DEVCON officer, your fellow active officers can be your local hosts when you visit Metro Manila. Officers start as volunteers. Start as a volunteer
